verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a QuickBooks Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks), but its documented employee use case is only "View employee information," alongside deductions, payslips and pensions. Nothing documents creating an employee, setting compensation, or configuring tax setup via the API. The automated hire-and-onboard flow and employee self-entry of tax info are UI features, not API capabilities, so they earn no credit for an agent-driven onboarding story.
